title: SmartSlot: The One-Stack Rule
description: release of SmartSlot: The One-Stack Rule. Limits inventory blocks to 64 units
body: Tired of your inventory getting clogged with 10 stacks of cobblestone? SmartSlot is a lightweight utility mod that limits blocks to a single stack (64 units). Once you have a full stack, any additional items of that type are automatically filtered out.
